what: Plan only guards oos-serialize.sh when OOS_ACCEPTED_COUNT>0; the existing else branch still truncates oos-accepted-review.md when oos.md is missing
scenario_or_breakage: After tally writes normalized accepted OOS under SESSION_ENV_PATH, a missing/removed oos.md lets emit-tally hit :> and wipe review-tmpdir content; copy_to_parent then overwrites the parent copy tally already wrote
suggested_fix: Restructure the OOS block so count>0 skips both serialize and truncate (no-op preserve); run serialize-or-truncate only when count==0
